description: KG construction parameters (data-handling settings, not domain rules). Domain rules are in configs/rules.json.
_readback_window_sec_note: A pilot transmission can be linked as a read-back only within this many seconds after the ATCO transmission; an instruction requiring read-back with no link inside the window raises NO_READBACK. katl_all: 351/404 links within 5 s, p95 12.4 s (measured inside the 20 s window).
_max_validity_sec_note: A state instruction that no later instruction supersedes (missed audio, flight left the frequency) is closed this many seconds after it started and marked expired. katl_all: 2,251 of 2,993 ATCO state instructions were closed this way. Values are design choices, not regulation.
